project_type: Mastra agent/workflow project with an in-process Satori (satori + @resvg/resvg-js) renderer for 1080x1350 Instagram posts, plus a separate EXTERNAL Python 'Design Agent' REST service for other templates.
build_system: npm + mastra CLI. tsconfig: target/module ES2022, moduleResolution 'bundler', strict, jsx react-jsx, types ['node'], include ['src/**/*']. Relative TS imports MUST use '.js' specifiers (e.g. './theme.js'). TypeScript 6.0.3 installed.
test_framework: No unit framework for this task; verification is `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) plus one-shot tsx demo scripts run via `npx -y tsx --env-file=.env <file>`. Existing render smoke test: `npm run ras:render:test` (src/mastra/demo/rasRenderTest.ts).
test_command: npm run typecheck && npm run ras:poster:test
verification_instructions: 1) npm install (idempotent; deps already present). 2) npm run typecheck must report 0 errors — the baseline is 6 TS7016 'cannot find declaration for sharp' errors and FEAT-001's shim removes all 6. 3) npm run ras:poster:test (added in FEAT-002) must exit 0: it builds poster props from a synthetic in-memory transparent PNG hero (sharp), omits the logo (text wordmark fallback), renders via renderComponentToPng, asserts a non-empty PNG starting with signature bytes 89 50 4E 47, and asserts loadFonts() has an {name:'Anton', weight:400} entry. 4) npm run ras:render:test must still run (existing RAS story path unbroken). Do NOT run `mastra dev`/`mastra build`/`npm run dev` — long-lived.
snapshot_or_generated_files: FEAT-002 copies node_modules/@fontsource/anton/files/anton-latin-400-normal.woff to src/mastra/assets/fonts/Anton-Regular.woff (a binary that gets committed). No code-generated/snapshot files otherwise.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell (chain with ';' not '&&'; $env:VAR not %VAR%). Never start long-lived processes (no mastra dev/watch). One-shot commands only. The Satori renderer is cwd-sensitive: Mastra dev's cwd is src/mastra/public, so NEVER read a font/asset via a bare cwd-relative path at module top level (that previously crashed boot). Use the cwd-safe getFontsDir()/getLogosDir() helpers in renderer/assets.ts. makeHeroCutout on an already-transparent PNG skips the ~140MB @imgly background-removal model, keeping the demo fast/offline.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: load the `mastra` skill before Mastra work; register ALL agents/tools/workflows/scorers in src/mastra/index.ts; use npm dev/build scripts, never `mastra dev`/`mastra build` directly. Match existing code style and the '.js' import specifier convention. Satori constraints: flexbox only, inline styles, explicit width/height, Latin glyphs only.
key_patterns: Mastra tools use createTool({ id, description, inputSchema: z.object(...), outputSchema, execute: async (inputData) => {...} }) from '@mastra/core/tools' — in THIS repo's tools the execute arg is the input object directly (see renderRasStoryTool). In-process render pattern (ras-render-tools.ts): resolveHeroImage/loadLocalLogo -> React.createElement(Template, props) -> renderComponentToPng(component, RAS_CANVAS) -> writeFileSync under ensureRasOutputDir(sanitizeSlug(slug)) -> return asset with rasViewUrl. Fonts load from a FONT_SPECS array in renderer/fonts.ts via readFileSync(join(getFontsDir(), file)); FontConfig.data is Buffer (readFileSync returns Buffer, no conversion). Accent colors come from ACCENT_COLORS in templates/theme.ts.
